definitions.full: H8563. tamrur I. [ תַּמְרוּר ] noun masculine bitterness ; — only plural intensive תַּמְרוּרִים Hosea 12:15 2 t.; — ת ׳מִסְמַּד Jer 6:26 mourning of bitterness (bitter mourning), so ת ׳בְּכִי 31:15 (compare the verb Isa 22:4 ; Zech 12:10 ); as adverb bitterly Hosea 12:15 (si vera lectio). — II.[[ תַּמְרוּר ] see below ת .
